messages:
Sam: Hey team, PR #5129 landed but CI is failing on gofumpt import grouping. I pushed a tiny follow-up that reordered imports — need one more reviewer to approve so we can merge before tomorrow's deploy window. cc @Ana @Mike
Ana: On it, will take a look in ~15m.
Mike: Saw the CI log — it's complaining about an unused fmt import in cmd/batcher/main.go. If Sam can remove that single import it's probably green.
Sam: Yep, pushed a fix at 5280002200 — removed fmt and ran gofumpt locally. @CI Bot can you re-run?
CI Bot: Build queued for commit sam/fix/import-order (job 789).
Ana: Quick note: LGTM apart from an optional naming nit — batcher.Run feels like RunBatch by our convention. Not necessary to block this merge though.
Mike: I vote we don't rename in this PR, keeps history clearer. We can track a refactor separately.
Sam: Sounds good. I'll leave the name as-is and merge after CI passes. Anyone object to me squashing the commits?
Ana: :thumbsup: squash is fine.
Mike: Fine by me.
CI Bot: Job 789: Success — all checks passed.
Sam: Merged. Thanks all. I'll open a short follow-up issue to track the Run -> RunBatch naming thread (low priority).
